notes.title: Version 0.5!
notes.notes:
Version 0.5:
This update focuses on huge rennovations, improvements in graphics, and lays the groundwork for the new direction for the game. 
Version 0.5 features a new Story and Episode format, from this point forward, each story will have Episodes, which are levels that you play throughout the Story. This way, I can have players enjoy multiple Stories, essentially multiple games in one, and each update will add episode after episode to a Story. This makes it so that I, as a solo developer, can still provide a steady stream of content, like watching a new episode of your favorite show every week!
You may notice that the older levels are no longer playable. They are not gone for good, the previous version were good for testing these gamemodes and I promise you all of them will return in the comming updates with more polish as you enjoy the Story of DANCEHALLBRAWL--TEMPEST TIDE.
TEMPEST TIDE is the first Story you will be able to play, and look forward to plenty of updates focusing on the story and fleshing it out.
What's that....there's another story other than DANCEHALLBRAWL?...thats a secret...for now.

-The game has full sound now, so no more awkward silence.
-District Central has been changed to a hub for saving and deleting data, please look forward to more quality of life changes in the future.
-The old Story has been removed and the upgrade system is being rennovated, for now, you can gather points to spend later.

The Next update will have cutscenes, better animations, upgrades, and more context. This update will give you a nice sneak peek as for whats to come

Thank you! And please look forward to update 0.6!

notes.title: Update 0.4.2 and THANK YOU
notes.notes:
First of all, THANK YOU ALL FOR PURCHASING! I know there isn't much content at the moment, but please stay tuned for frequent content updates and improvements. The sale has been going amazingly with 70+ new players! I encourage all of you to visit my twitter @PSYKYO_DYSFI and YouTube channel PSY-KYO DYSFI so that you can stay up to date on all the news and stuff I've been working on! I also have a Patreon for those who want more power and exclusive content: https://www.patreon.com/PSYKYODYSFI?fan_landing=true

Version 0.4.2:
-Added a new Level--The Valloralla GATEBREAKER! This is the second battle in the Valloralla story arc.
-You can now upgrade the PARRY and TAILWHIP!
-Made a new Map thats simple, easy, and functional!
-Added more menu sound effects
-Redid a few cutscenes. Please know that these are very simple, but eventually they will be redesigned in a much more polished state as development progresses.
-You may notice a severe lack of sound effects, over the next few updates i'll start to trickle them in, rather than have an update only dedicated to sounds.

notes.title: Update 0.4.1 (Bug Fixes)
notes.notes:
Version 0.4.1:
-Fixed an issue where players 1-shot Glitchika. This was because while testing, I set her Hp to 1 to test out the new win/lose screens.
Now her Hp has been set back to 90, like it's supposed to be. Sorry about that!
-I also disabled the map for now, because in the next update the map will kook a bit different, and in it's current state it caused a crash.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Version 0.4:
-Completely remodeled District Central to a much larger and more open look
-Removed old cutscenes and added some new ones! Still a work in progress though!
-Added a Brand new Tutorial that should help newer players understand how to play better
-Added a new Level--Willy! A simple introductory Turn-style battle that will set the precedent for rest of the story
-Added a couple new menu's and improved the look of many of them.
-You can now upgrade the SPECIAL-CHAIN

Adjustments:
-Made ACTION Veta's movements much sharper, greatly reducing sliding while walking.
-SLIDE is 14% faster
-Added a fast fall to help players dodge attacks and land more tailwhips!
-Improved Glitchika's level design a bit more.
-Fixed a bug that did not allow players to save their rank on Glitchika

Thank you! And please look forward to update 0.5!

notes.title: Version 0.3!
notes.notes:
Update Notes:
Version 0.3:
-Added a new level: GLITCHIKA! Showcasing a new gamemode: TURN-STYLE
-Added more to the info tab to help newer players learn the controls
-Still no sound effects :( i make them all myself so please be a little more patient with me.
-Added a new ability...SPECIALS!! You now have a "Special Chain" (Or Special Bar) and you can now do special versions of certain moves!
-Made the Death Screen look better.

-Made several visual changes to polish up transitions and improve
the look of several UI elements.
-There is some New opening dialougue when you start a New Game.
-And more little things to improve the state of the game.
-Stay tuned for Version 0.4!
